Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice (intent or reckless disregard); inadvertently forgetting the stove is mere negligence, and arson is not defined as requiring some separate underlying felony.

Q9000.reason: GA resolutions are not formal sources and do not always codify custom; they are material sources that may enunciate or evidence customary law.

Q9002.reason: “Provided that if … may re-enter” is a condition subsequent plus a right of entry, so the estate does not end automatically.
